campo-base.descrizione: The foundations Docker is built on: how a computer works, the terminal, Linux and networking.
campo-base.boss: Set up a project folder from the terminal and explain why an app fails on another computer.

primi-passi.descrizione: Install Docker, start your first containers, pull images, open ports and keep data that does not disappear.
primi-passi.boss: Run a database and an admin panel, with data that survives deleting the container.

costruire-immagini.descrizione: Write Dockerfiles, package real applications and learn to get images that are small and quick to build.
costruire-immagini.boss: Containerize a provided app from scratch, with an image under a maximum size.

multi-container.descrizione: Let containers talk to each other and describe a whole application in one file with Docker Compose.
multi-container.boss: Fix a broken stack: networks, ports, variables and startup order to correct.

devops.descrizione: Git, registries and automated pipelines: from code to a published image with no manual steps.
devops.boss: Build a pipeline that, on every push, tests the app, builds the image and publishes it with the right tag.

produzione.descrizione: Security, servers, HTTPS, logs and a method to solve problems when something breaks.
produzione.boss: Deploy the World 3 stack to production over HTTPS and fix a simulated failure.

oltre.descrizione: When you need an orchestrator, how to keep learning on your own, and the final project.
oltre.boss: Final project: your own app, from Dockerfile to deployment, with a pipeline and a security checklist.

livelli.dati: Data that does not disappear (if you know how)
livelli.app-in-immagine: A real app in an image
